speakerNames.label: Prospect
speakerNames.name: Marcus
speakerNames.quote: Hey Marcus. Can you hear me? You were breaking up a second ago.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Marcus. Can you hear me? You were breaking up a second ago.

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Yeah, no, I can hear you now. Sorry, I was on the other network.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No worries. Right, you've got a hard stop at half past?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Half past, yeah. I've got another one straight after, so.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay. So last time you were going to take the notes thing back to the team. How did that go?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Mm. Mixed, honestly.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Mixed how?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: So the team liked it. Like, everyone who actually saw the notes bit liked it, that wasn't the issue. The issue is the number.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Right.

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: It's the number.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Say more about the number.

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Well, we're — okay so we're looking at fourteen seats, right? And at your list that's, what, north of forty thousand a year. We spent about twelve on the whole sales stack last year. So.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah. That's a real jump. I'm not going to pretend it isn't.

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: We're not sure we can justify that pricing right now.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally fair. What would need to be true for it to make sense?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Honestly? Honestly we'd need buy-in from finance, and Dave owns that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Is Dave someone who wants a business case, or does he need to hear it from the team?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Business case. He'll want to see what we stop paying for. That's — that's the conversation, really.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: So what are you paying for today that overlaps?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: We've got Chorus. That's about nine a year. And nobody, I mean nobody uses the coaching side of it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: So the recording spend is real, the coaching spend is shelfware.

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Pretty much, yeah.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Do you know why the coaching side didn't stick?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Adoption was maybe thirty percent in the first quarter and then it just fell off.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Any sense of what caused that?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Reps didn't trust the summaries. You'd read one and it'd say the customer was ready to buy, and then you'd listen back and they said nothing like that. Once that happens twice you stop opening it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah. That's the thing we built around, so. Every line in ours points back at the moment in the call.

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: I saw that in the demo. That part I believed.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: So if I put the offset together — Chorus spend against ours — is that the shape of what Dave needs?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: That plus something on time saved. Our reps spend, what, forty minutes a day writing things up in the CRM. Maybe more.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Forty minutes across how many?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Fourteen. Same as the seats.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay. So I'll do a one-pager, the offset and the time math. When does Dave need it?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: He does budget reviews Thursdays. If it's in his inbox Wednesday he'll have read it.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Wednesday. Do you want to be on that call with him or should I go direct?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: No, send it to me first. I'll forward it. He'll ignore a vendor email but he won't ignore mine.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Understood. Anything else that could sink this before it gets to him?

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Erm. Security review, eventually. But that's not a blocker for the budget conversation, that's after.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Good. I'll keep the page to money and time then.

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: Yeah. Dave doesn't read past page one, so.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Noted. I'll get it to you Tuesday, gives you a day.

segments.speaker: Prospect
segments.text: That works. Right, I've got to jump.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Thanks Marcus. Tuesday.
